---
name: requirements-review
description: Reconcile proposed requirements with repository discovery and identify gaps.
agent: architect
---

Review discovery findings and `docs/01-PRODUCT-REQUIREMENTS.md`.

Produce a requirements review with:
- Confirmed, changed, deferred and rejected requirements.
- User personas and workflows.
- Functional/non-functional requirements with unique IDs.
- MVP vs later releases.
- Explicit exclusions.
- Open decisions and assumptions.
- Acceptance criteria that can be tested.

Do not implement. Do not assume approvals. Update the PRD only if the owner has authorized documentation edits. Finish with `NEEDS APPROVAL` and request `APPROVE REQUIREMENTS v1` or specific changes.
